lines: He alone conquers — Śiva, throbbing, self-established — who savors the inner face.
Victorious is this hero, the Kula’s lord.
sanskrit_cite: sa jayati śiva ekaḥ spandavānsvapratiṣṭhaḥ yo'ntarvaktraṃ rasayati jayatyeṣa vīraḥ kulendraḥ
notes: single T1/L0 record spans both verses; lines split v1/v2 positionally (9+4 tokens)
